Our Services

Everything Your Pup Needs

From first-time puppies to senior sweethearts — every dog is treated with patience and love.

Full Groom

Complete package — bath, blow-dry, breed-specific cut, nail trim, ear cleaning, and a cute bandana to take home.

Bath & Brush

Shampoo, conditioning rinse, blow-dry, thorough brush-out, nail trim, and ear cleaning — no haircut.

Nail Trim

Quick, stress-free nail trimming to keep your dog comfortable. Add-on or standalone — walk-ins welcome.

Senior Dog Care

Gentle, patient grooming for older dogs. We take breaks and go at their pace to ensure full comfort.

Anxiety-Friendly

Specialized care for nervous or reactive dogs. We use calming techniques and go at their pace — no rush.

Puppy's First Groom

A gentle, fun introduction to grooming. We build positive associations so puppies love coming back!
